parameter: Seaweed annual yield per hectare of offshore farm (kg DW ha‑1 yr‑1)
evidence: Kautsky et al., *Marine Policy* 2021; pilot farms in Øygarden reported 2.5 t DW ha‑1 yr‑1 average over 3 years.
analogy: Offshore brown seaweed farms in Norway (Laminaria spp.)

evidence: FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture Technical Paper 2020; moisture 84 % (±2 %).
analogy: Harvested wet brown seaweed moisture from Irish seaweed industry reports

parameter: Drying energy requirement (kWh kg‑1 wet biomass)
evidence: Experimental dryer reported 0.38 MJ kg‑1 water removed; total specific electricity 0.42 kWh kg‑1 wet seaweed.
analogy: Solar‑assisted dryer for kelp in Chile (Gómez‑Pérez et al., *Bioresour Technol* 2022)

parameter: Alginate extraction efficiency (kg alginate per kg dry seaweed)
evidence: Reported 0.31 kg alginate per kg DW at 2 % NaOH, 90 °C, 2 h extraction.
analogy: Alginate extraction from brown seaweed in Japanese pilot plant (Matsumoto et al., *J. Appl. Polym. Sci.* 2020)

parameter: Alkali consumption (kg NaOH per kg alginate produced)
evidence: FMC disclosed 0.44 kg NaOH kg‑1 alginate in 2018 production audit.
analogy: Industrial alginate extraction data from FMC (now DuPont) plant, 2018 annual report

parameter: Water recycle ratio in extraction (m3 water reused per m3 fresh water)
evidence: Pilot study reported 4:1 recycle to fresh water ratio with <5 % quality loss.
analogy: Algae biorefinery water recycling scheme (Liu et al., *Renew Energy* 2021)

parameter: Plasticiser loading level (wt % of alginate in final polymer)
evidence: Optimal mechanical properties reported at 25 % glycerol by weight of dry alginate.
analogy: Alginate‑glycerol bioplastic films (Santos et al., *Carbohydr Polym* 2022)

parameter: Compounding energy consumption (kWh kg‑1 polymer blend)
evidence: Measured specific electricity 0.68 kWh kg‑1 for 30 % glycerol starch blend.
analogy: Compounding of starch‑based bioplastics in a 30 t h‑1 extruder (Zhang et al., *Polym Degrad Stab* 2020)

parameter: Film extrusion specific energy (kWh kg‑1 film)
evidence: NatureWorks disclosed 0.38 kWh kg‑1 for 30 µm PLA film; adjusted +10 % for higher water content of alginate blend.
analogy: Industrial extrusion of PLA film (NatureWorks, 2021 plant data)
Measured density of alginate‑glycerol films (Mendoza et al., *J. Clean Prod.* 2023)

parameter: Transport distance seaweed farm to shore (km)
evidence: GIS analysis of farm locations shows average 24.7 km to shore.
analogy: Norwegian offshore kelp farms logistics (Kautsky et al., 2021)

parameter: Boat fuel consumption rate (L h‑1) and harvest duration per cycle
evidence: Operational logs show 11.8 L h‑1 average during active hauling.
analogy: Fuel use of Irish seaweed harvest vessels (Marine Harvest Report 2022)

parameter: Co‑product residue to fertiliser (kg residue per kg alginate)
evidence: Mass balance indicated 2.2 kg solid residue per kg alginate produced.
analogy: Residue streams from Japanese alginate plants (Matsumoto et al., 2020)

parameter: Biogas methane content and conversion efficiency to electricity (kWh m3‑1 CH4)
evidence: Reported 0.55 CH4 fraction and 34 % net electricity conversion.
analogy: Seaweed AD pilot in Denmark (Jensen et al., *Energy* 2020)

parameter: Industrial composting methane emissions factor (kg CH4 kg‑1 composted)
evidence: Average CH4 factor for biodegradable plastics = 0.014 kg CH4 kg‑1.

parameter: Recycling capture rate for bioplastic film (%)
analogy: Mechanical recycling trials of alginate‑based films in Germany (Klein et al., *Waste Manage* 2022)

evidence: Average methane capture reported as 74 % across EU member states.
